Witnessed via the SCRY half of Serum Visions (oracle 'Draw a card. Scry 2.'). The parser splits the spell into two flat sibling effects; the scry sentence 'Scry 2.' matches ScrySpellRule (^Scry\s+\d+$) -> a clean ScryEffect{Count={QuantityType:literal, Value:2}}, verified via `dotnet run --project apps/mast-query-cli -- --dump "Serum Visions"` (Abilities[0].Kind=spell, Effects=[drawCards{1,You}, scry{literal 2}]). A faithful witness, not a wish. Scry (not surveil) is the SMALLEST honest unit for cards:select: CR 701.22a -- 'scry N means look at the top N cards of YOUR library, then put any number on the bottom in any order and the rest on top in any order' -- is a pure top-N peek+reorder with NO zone change (bottom-of-library is still library). Surveil (CR 701.25) was deliberately NOT chosen: it optionally moves cards to the graveyard, a zone move that muddies the 'no zone move' distinction the hole names.
